annotations.title: Set a lead's stage or owner

description:
[writes · `write` scope, or `ads:manage`] Sets a lead's stage (new, contacted, qualified, won, lost) and/or owner (a user who receives the lead; null clears it). The stage is mirrored to the Meta lead record where it has one. Moves no money and sends nothing to the lead.
(Wraps PATCH /api/v2/ads/leads/{leadId}.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands); the lead must belong to it.

leadId.description: The Meta lead id (leadgen id), or a site form lead id with source=site.

ownerId.description: A user id, or null to clear the owner.

name: ads_lead_update
title: Set a lead's stage or owner
